nodes.name: Save scores to Supabase
nodes.notes: One bulk upsert of every score + reasoning.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify($input.all().map(i => ({ company_key: i.json.company_key, gate_passed: i.json.gate_passed, open_to_lagos: i.json.open_to_lagos, icp_score: i.json.icp_score, icp_reasoning: i.json.icp_reasoning, scored_at: i.json.scored_at }))) }}

nodes.name: Upsert to Salesforce
nodes.notes: Composite upsert on Domain__c, up to 200 per call.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify($input.all().filter(i => i.json.ok).map(i => ({ company_key: i.json.company_key, sf_synced: true, sf_account_id: i.json.sf_account_id }))) }}

parameters.jsCode: return $input.all().filter(i => !i.json.ok).map(i => ({ json: { node: 'Upsert to Salesforce', error: i.json.error, payload: i.json.record } }));

return { json: { node: 'Upsert to Salesforce (whole batch)', error: String($json.error?.message || $json.error || 'unknown error').slice(0, 500), payload: { keys: $('Build Salesforce batches').item.json.keys } } };
